description: Durable storage cannot commit (disk full, inbox write failure).

expected_upstream.notes: Relational path: the save throws and serverError returns 500. Kafka path: sendMessage logs and returns [], so the handler answers 200 for an event that was not stored.

expected_holocron.notes: 503 with Retry-After and the serviceUnavailable envelope (src/lib/response.ts:57-64) (docs/decisions/0005, backpressure and lost client events). The unchanged tracker and recorder never retry, so the event is lost on the client; refusals count in refused_backpressure{route, reason} and show as lost client events. Retry-After helps only server integrations. One such refusal during the agreed 500 events/s burst fails the capacity gate.

validation_reason: Needs a fault injected into Holocron storage. Upstream behaviour is from source reading only; the harness does not run Kafka or break PostgreSQL.
